name: StockpileBlendPlanner
tagline: ROM stockpile inventory, reclaim blend planning to spec and book-vs-survey reconciliation in one Power Apps control.
description: A complete mine-production app for Canvas and Model-driven apps. It covers the stockpile register with status rules, a drag-and-drop yard board, a blend planner and optimiser that hits grade windows and impurity limits, and a movement log with book-vs-survey reconciliation. Demo data is built in, it connects to any data source with low-code column mapping, and it raises Power Fx events.
features: Blend optimiser (tonnes, grade window, 3 assay limits, minimum draw, locks)
Movements: stack, reclaim, survey adjustment, write-off
Book vs survey reconciliation with tolerance flags
Bulk status, CSV export, delete with undo
pack: Niray Mining & Natural Resources PCF Pack
